observation: The existing MoE routing emitter calls tl.topk, but the shared native-source allowlist omits it. The existing QSA streaming/half-selection emitter also uses cat, sort, bitonic_merge and split omitted at the same boundary. Target capability admission and native SDK compilation are separate; this source-level refusal occurs before either native compilation or device execution.
proposed_change: Admit only the five existing selection-emitter language calls at the shared source boundary, retain direct-module and closed-call restrictions, and replay the real MoE/QSA emissions through canonical kernel projection. No target capability, dtype, oracle or emitted selection algorithm changes.
